# Uruguay vs Panama: All-time head-to-head record | Copa America 2024
[...]
## La Celeste are one of the exciting teams at the Copa America 2024 tournament.
[...]
Uruguay are full of confidence going into the Copa America 2024 and they have every reason to think they can win a record 16th title.
[...]
With just one loss in four games (2-1 defeat against the Ivory Coast), Marcelo Bielsa’s team have been comparatively consistent this year. They won their last three games of 2023. Bielsa’s team can anticipate playing at a very high level for ninety minutes and engaging in nonstop pressing.
[...]
Surprisingly, though,Uruguayhave remained comparatively clean defensively despite this aggressive strategy, maintaining five clean sheets in their last seven international games.
[...]
The Uruguayans haven’t won their first group match at this event since the 2019 Copa America, but they did win their last two group matches in 2021.
[...]
Since the competition’s last stop in the United States (2016), when Los Charruas lost 3-1 toMexico, the team has not been defeated by a CONCACAF team.
[...]
Panama, who are participating in their secondCopa America, will be looking to build on their successful first two qualifiers for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
[...]
Los Canaleros have proven they can compete above their weight under Thomas Christiansen, who like Bielsa had managed Leeds United. They made it to the 2023 CONCACAF Gold Cup final and placed fourth in the most current Nations League.
[...]
Their performance against CONMEBOL rivals, however, has been inconsistent. In nine previous encounters, Panama have only triumphed once (2-1 over Bolivia in the previous year). But in four of those encounters, including a historic 1-1 draw withBrazilin 2019, they have claimed victories.
